songs.title: Operation Countdown
songs.about: The opening briefing. Staccato strings, brass stabs, and a clock that will not stop.

songs.title: Operation Fuse
songs.about: The fuse is lit. Brass and a bass line that will not sit still.

songs.title: Operation Riptide
songs.about: Surf guitar on the night shift. Twang, reverb, and full speed.

songs.title: Operation Undertow
songs.about: The surf rock file, pulled deeper. Tremolo guitar and big brass.

songs.title: Operation Night Watch
songs.about: A lo-fi stakeout. Muted trumpet, soft rain, and a long night.

songs.title: Operation Cold Coffee
songs.about: Still on the stakeout. Quiet piano and a coffee gone cold.

songs.title: Operation Slapback
songs.about: Slap bass and electronic drums. The chase is on.

songs.title: Operation Drop Zone
songs.about: Risers, then the drop. Full brass and bass to close the file.

songs.title: Wiretap
songs.about: The newest HQ intro. Part of the broadcast rotation.

songs.title: Glass Alibi
songs.about: One of the HQ intros in the broadcast rotation.

songs.title: Dead Drop
songs.about: One of the HQ intros in the broadcast rotation.

songs.title: Chrome Cipher
songs.about: One of the HQ intros in the broadcast rotation.

songs.title: Black Tie
songs.about: The title track. Twangy guitar, big brass, and a bow tie pulled tight.

songs.title: Silver Fox
songs.about: Cool, calm, and one step ahead. Low guitar and soaring horns.

songs.title: High Roller
songs.about: Big band swing at the casino table. Muted trumpets and a sly guitar.

songs.title: Last Call
songs.about: The lounge is closing. Warm saxophone and one last brass hit.

songs.title: Fast Exit
songs.about: Neon lights and a getaway. Synth bass and a racing beat.

songs.title: Red Light Run
songs.about: No stopping now. Driving synths and a twangy lead.

songs.title: Zero Hour
songs.about: The clock runs out. Ticking strings, then huge drums and booming brass.

songs.title: Shockwave
songs.about: The final blast. Orchestral hits and brass to close the night.

songs.title: Belle's Takeover
songs.about: Belle's theme song. She runs the show.

songs.title: Raid on HQ
songs.about: Plays when a raid lands at HQ.

songs.title: Sealed In
songs.about: Welcome to the fold. Once you're in, you're in.
